held.why: REFUSED: Misleading: "You need a letter to close both words." The letter ends the first word but STARTS the second; "close both" states the rule wrongly, and it is the very slip the wrong options catch. Working otherwise correct: stamp and pond; b gives bond only, a gives neither.
REFUSED: Form: "A n builds crown and nest." is wrong English; the letter n takes "an" ("An n ..."). Working otherwise correct: crown and nest; d gives crowd only, b gives best only.
